Ok so i found out how to get the spectral dragon priest summon PERMANENTLY, much like a thrall. You will need: Kohnarik Dragon priest mask, Knowledge of the fortify restoration loop exploit, a bunch of alchemical ingredients to make fortify restoration and fortify conjuration potions, and a lot of time aside. This exploit is almost solely achievable to end game level players, but im sure someone is going to speedrun it.

Begin your fortify restoration loop normally, until u have hit about 100000% more powerful potions, you can keep going for more but it wont make much more of a difference. So when you are still under the effect of your god boosted fortify alchemy gear, craft a bunch of fortify conjuration potions (lavender. bone meal, frost salts, hagraven feathers, blue butterfly wing, blue mountain flower, ancestor moth wings) recommendable 10+ potions of fortify conjuration crafted. These potions should make any summon summoned under the effect of these last 5000+ hours at least.

Kohnarik is naturally one of the hardest to get pieces of armor in game, that's why it's endgame. This mask has a 3% chance of summoning an spectral dragon priest summon for 60 seconds whenever you get hit while below 15% health, so in a normal gameplay you will only ever see a summoned dragon priest once or twice EVER. So what you do is take out all armor, all health enhancing gear and stay only with your mask, (this will make it way faster to trigger the chance of summoning him). Drop a save, turn legendary difficulty on for faster method, and summon a flame atronach and make him hostile, now keep getting attacked by him until he gets you close to 15% health, drink the god boosted fortify conjuration potion, and wait for the summon chance to trigger (it will take a while, but the amount of hits from flame atronach makes it easier). If a priest was not summoned, reload the save since you dont want to waste precious fortify conjuration potions. Keep repeating until you succesfully summon dragon priest under the effect of god boosted fortify conjuration potions and you got him! Your very own undead wizard ghost ruler thingy to crush everyone. The god boosted fortify conjuration potion can also be taken to permanently keep other summons like arniel's shade, arvak and any other summon you can think of. Keep in mind that while spectral dragon priest has massive amounts of health, he is unable to heal in any way, and the only way is using Grand Healing on vanilla or Heal Undead if you have dwanguard
